image_location_description: Top of the model head; rounded light-blonde hair mass with slight forehead overhang.

steps.title: Base footprint
steps.description: Place 1x 3022 Tan; add 2x 3023 Tan to extend to a 2x4 plate.

steps.title: Top cap plate
steps.description: Attach 1x 3037 Yellow (2x4) plate on top, aligned with the base.

steps.title: Shaggy edge slopes
steps.description: Add 4x 3040b Tan slopes on the 4 edges, sloping down/out.

steps.title: Forehead swoop
steps.description: Add 2x 3023 Yellow (1x2) plates at front, offset 1 stud to overhang.
